verdict.rationale: a-Shell is fully open source under the FreeBSD license and runs entirely locally on the user's iOS device with no cloud dependency, so the core product is effectively under the user's control. Even its optional relay HTTPS server runs inside the app. However, the evidence does not document how to build or deploy the product yourself, and it ships via the App Store. missing for 10: documented build-from-source/self-deployment instructions, independent hands-on corroboration of self-built installs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: a-Shell is entirely OpenSource, and released under the FreeBSD license.
The goal in this project is to provide a simple Unix-like terminal on iOS.
a-Shell is a local iOS terminal whose only programmatic surfaces are local
